day8_to_day9_interface_decision: Day 8 expected_goals_home and expected_goals_away are the canonical pre-match goal intensities for Day 9. The Day 9 scoreline layer does not fit a second competing goals model. It applies Dixon-Coles low-score dependence around those fixed intensities.
day8_to_day9_interface_justification: This avoids bypassing the closed Day 8 conversion layer and avoids double-counting the venue effect already present in the competition-and-venue Day 8 conversion.
gamma_handling_description: The explicit Dixon-Coles home-advantage gamma term is not re-estimated in Day 9 because the Day 8 competition-and-venue conversion already produces asymmetric home and away goal intensities. Adding gamma here would create a second home-advantage channel and risk double-counting.
truncation_policy_description: Construct the 0..10 x 0..10 matrix, record the raw in-matrix mass and the tail mass beyond 10 from the independent Poisson baseline, then renormalize the in-matrix probabilities to sum to one. Tail mass is preserved as a separate diagnostic field rather than silently discarded.
rho_fit_objective_description: Fit rho on prior historical score outcomes only by maximizing the canonical Dixon-Coles low-score-adjusted observed-score log likelihood. No betting ROI objective is used.
time_decay_selection_policy_description: Compare the fixed xi grid using only prior out-of-sample fold log likelihood. Default to the simpler flat-weight xi=0.0 before any comparison evidence exists and prefer xi=0.0 on ties.
